coverImageAlt: Layered miniature city under a translucent dome joined by glowing cyan conduits and an orange central junction.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Technology architecture represented by a compact cutaway city of infrastructure layers—foundation, compute towers, data conduits, integration bridges, and protective canopy—assembled into one comprehensible system, conveying rigorous architecture documentation without depicting a diagram or software interface.
Scene/backdrop: An uncluttered warm-paper drafting landscape with a dark slate ground plane.
Subject: One crop-safe isometric architectural model with stacked stone and navy platforms, cyan conduits linking distinct components, a translucent protective canopy, and one orange junction defining the system boundary.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one dominant central layered-city silhouette with clear depth; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: engineered, dependable, legible; cool architectural light with warm paper bounce
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: use only physical architectural forms and plain conduits; no network glyphs, labels, diagrams, screens, or dashboards; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
